essence: Offering full-blown white lotuses secures the obtaining of a son.
Offering bilva flowers brings great prosperity.
One desiring rain should offer oblations with the best cane fuel sticks.
A mantra practitioner should offer honey for three days to achieve subjugation.
These afflictions are the occasions for the prescribed protective rite.
